fields.h1: Build an Offboarding Workflow That Finishes Every Exit Step

fields.features_heading: Every Exit Task on One Record
fields.features_subheading: Each departure gets one record with the handover, the equipment, the payroll hand-off, and the exit survey on it.
fields.feature_1:
A record the day HR enters a last day

The app reads your HR system through its API and opens an offboarding record as soon as HR enters a last day. Each exit task on the record gets a named owner and a due date.
fields.feature_2:
A successor for every client and project

The record lists the departing employee's client accounts and open projects. Each one needs a named successor before the last day, and the manager sees which are unassigned.
fields.feature_3:
Equipment tracked until it comes back

Every laptop and badge assigned to the departing employee is listed with its return status. If an item is still out after the last day, the app alerts IT in Slack or by email.
fields.feature_4:
Final pay details handed to payroll

When HR confirms the end date, the app sends payroll that date, the unused PTO hours on record, and any open expense report. Payroll applies its own rules and marks it received.
fields.feature_5:
Leaver feedback that only HR reads

On the last day the app sends the leaver a short survey, one question per screen. Answers land in a database you own, and the HR dashboard groups them by the reason given.
fields.feature_6:
The offboarding app's code in your GitHub

Export the app's full code to your GitHub repository on paid plans. Your team can review how exit records and survey answers are stored, and who has permission to open them.

fields.tab_content_1:
Each client account gets a successor before the last day

Tobias Quennell gives notice as an account manager at Wexcombe Insurance Brokers, and the app lists his 8 client accounts on his offboarding record. Six of the 8 have a named successor. Five business days before his last day, his manager, Imogen Varga, gets a direct message naming the 2 accounts still without one.
fields.tab_content_2:
A laptop still out 7 days after the last day goes to IT

Priya Lindqvist works from home as an analyst at Saltmarsh Analytics, and her record lists 3 items to return. The monitor and the headset are checked in, and the laptop is not. Seven days after her last day, the IT asset lead, Dorian Achterberg, gets a direct message about the laptop.
fields.tab_content_3:
Payroll gets one hand-off the day HR confirms the last day

HR at Corrigan Dental Partners confirms the last day for Elspeth Moranis, a dental hygienist. The payroll specialist, Joaquin Pellew, gets one hand-off with that date, 38 unused PTO hours, and 1 open expense report for $214.60. He applies the company's final-pay rules and marks it received.
fields.tab_content_4:
Pay comes up in 6 of 14 leavers' answers

Halverd Outdoor Co. sends every leaver a 5-question exit survey on the last day. Last quarter, 14 of 18 leavers answered: 6 named pay, 4 named growth, 3 named shifts, and 1 named a move. The HR lead, Annika Strand, reads the answers on a dashboard that managers cannot open.

fields.howto_title: How to Build an Offboarding Workflow
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to plan an offboarding workflow with an owner on every exit task, then build it with Emergent and test it.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 List every exit task you run
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Pick the event that opens the record
fields.howto_step_1_des: Write down each task between the day notice is given and the week after the last day: the client handover, equipment, payroll, the exit survey, and the accounts IT closes. Next to each one, note who does it today and how they hear about it.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Choose one event that starts every offboarding, such as HR entering a last day in your HR system. Starting from one event keeps a resignation and a dismissal on the same path, with the same owners and the same deadlines.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Name one role for every task, such as the manager for the handover or the IT asset lead for equipment. Count each deadline in days from the last day, so a later last day moves every deadline along with it.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Connect your HR system and payroll provider through their APIs. The app reads the last day and the unused PTO from the HR system, and it alerts each owner in Slack or by email when a task comes due.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Keep the exit survey short: one question on the main reason for leaving, and a few on the role and the team. Decide who can read the answers, and set that access before the first leaver gets the survey.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Write a prompt that names the opening event and each task with its owner, deadline, and alert. Emergent builds the app and its database along with the HR dashboard, and you change any step by prompting again.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Test it on one past departure
fields.howto_step_7_des: Run a recent departure through the app with its real dates and owners. Check that every task opened, each alert reached the right person, and payroll got its hand-off, then fix anything missed before the next notice comes in.

faq_plan.a: An offboarding workflow is the set of exit tasks a company runs for a departing employee, each assigned to a person with a deadline. Employee offboarding describes the separation process when an employee leaves a company, and the workflow tracks each part of it until the last task is closed.

faq_plan.q: How do I create an offboarding workflow?
faq_plan.a: List every exit task, choose the event that starts each offboarding, and assign every task a person and a deadline. Then describe it in a prompt to Emergent's AI automation builder, which builds the app with its alerts and an HR dashboard. Run one past departure through it before the next notice.

faq_plan.q: What forms belong in an offboarding workflow?
faq_plan.a: Use the forms your own exit steps need: the separation record HR fills in, a handover list of clients and open work, an equipment return checklist, and the exit survey. Each form becomes a step on the record with one owner. Ask HR which separation documents you keep on file. Emergent sets no response cap on the forms the app collects.

faq_plan.q: How does an offboarding workflow differ from onboarding?
faq_plan.a: It runs the same pattern in reverse. An employee onboarding workflow opens a record when an offer is accepted and works toward the first day. An offboarding workflow opens one when HR enters a last day and works toward the client handover, returned equipment, and a finished exit survey. Both track who owns each task and when it is due.

faq_plan.q: When should an offboarding workflow start?
faq_plan.a: Start it the day HR enters a confirmed last day, not on the last day itself. That leaves the manager time to name successors and gives IT time to arrange returns. Set each due date relative to the last day, and a changed date shifts the whole schedule instead of leaving old deadlines behind.

faq_plan.q: How do remote employees return equipment in an offboarding workflow?
faq_plan.a: List every item assigned to the employee on the record, and send return instructions as soon as the last day is set. IT marks each item when it is checked in. Anything still out a set number of days later is flagged to the IT asset lead, and you pick that number to fit how long shipping takes.

faq_plan.q: How should an offboarding workflow hand over a departing employee's clients?
faq_plan.a: Have the manager name a successor for every client account the employee owns, well before the last day. Pass along the account notes and open items, and introduce the successor while the departing employee is still there. If your team runs a client onboarding workflow, add each successor to it, and the client meets the new owner the way a new client does.

faq_plan.q: Who should read leaver feedback in an offboarding workflow?
faq_plan.a: Keep individual answers with HR, and decide that before the first leaver answers. Managers can get a summary by reason for leaving instead of named answers. Emergent builds the questions and the HR dashboard from your prompt, and the answers stay in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: How does an offboarding workflow pass final pay details to payroll?
faq_plan.a: It sends payroll one hand-off when HR confirms the last day, with that date, the PTO balance still unused, and any expense report not yet paid. Payroll then applies whatever final-pay rules cover that employee, and the workflow only carries the details. Those details come from the HR system, which the app reads through its API.

faq_plan.q: Can an offboarding workflow start the search for a replacement?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Once the last day is in the HR system, the workflow can ask the manager whether the role will be backfilled and open a hiring request with the job title and team. From there, recruitment automation takes over posting the role and scheduling interviews.

plan.angle: The top 10 are HR blog checklists and security explainers that list exit steps but never show them running. This page treats offboarding as one workflow that opens when HR records a last day and gives every exit task an owner and a deadline, then shows it running for four employers: a client handover that needs a successor on every account, equipment that has to come back from a remote employee, a final-pay hand-off to payroll, and an exit survey HR reads by reason. Closing accounts is left to the user provisioning page; hiring the replacement is left to recruitment automation.
